name: qwen3.6-27b-bf16-b200-maxctx-mtp2
notes: Full-weight Qwen3.6-27B BF16/BFloat16 B200 profile for comparison against FP8/NVFP4. HF repo contains mtp.* weights in model shards, so this profile enables Qwen MTP n=2. Uses max_num_seqs=512 so runtime client concurrency sweeps are not artificially capped; keep KV saturation controlled at the workload/control-plane layer. R2 transfer must use --stream; repo is about 55.6 GB and should not be staged locally.
